# Modifications

This copy of [pddl_plus_parser](https://github.com/argaman-aloni/pddl_plus_parser) is vendored by
OHCAM and has been modified from upstream commit `a5253de` (2026-03-10). It remains under the
original MIT license in `LICENSE`.

Changes, by Jeff Jewett (2026):
- Relaxed pinned versions in `requirements.txt`.
- More robust parsing in `lisp_parsers/domain_parser.py` and `models/pddl_predicate.py`.
